name: PLUS
aliases: Mirabegron add-on to tamsulosin in men
question: In men with persistent overactive bladder symptoms while taking tamsulosin for LUTS attributed to BPH, does mirabegron add-on reduce daily micturitions more than placebo add-on?

design.population: Men with persistent overactive bladder symptoms while receiving tamsulosin for lower urinary tract symptoms attributed to benign prostatic hyperplasia.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 4 randomized trial
design.locator: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02757768, Participant Flow, Started; PubMed abstract, Methods

verdictNote: The adjusted benefit was 0.39 fewer micturitions per day.
takeaway: In PLUS, mirabegron added to tamsulosin reduced daily micturitions more than placebo added to tamsulosin after 12 weeks (adjusted difference −0.39 per day, 95% CI −0.76 to −0.02).

reports.label: Primary efficacy report
reports.citation: Kaplan SA, Herschorn S, McVary KT, et al. Efficacy and Safety of Mirabegron versus Placebo Add-On Therapy in Men with Overactive Bladder Symptoms Receiving Tamsulosin for Underlying Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia: A Randomized, Phase 4 Study (PLUS). *J Urol.* 2020;203(6):1163-1171.
